item.title: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5：更便宜的 AI 模型，赋能编码、代理与企业工作流
item.summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 on Friday, a model the company says delivers nearly all the intelligence of its top-of-the-line Claude Fable 5 at half the cost — a launch that signals how the AI race is shifting from raw capability to the economics of daily use.
